name: Traceability

subjectOf.text: The legacy infrastructure bridge between fiat and crypto currencies accelerates the growth of the blockchain based economy and infrastructure, but it cannot curtail the anonymous nature of that economy.
subjectOf.abstract: The legacy infrastructure bridge (fiat to crypto currencies) accelerates the growth of the blockchain-based economy and infrastructure but cannot curtail its anonymous nature.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
scope_conditions: fiat to crypto currency conversion channels

subjectOf.text: Conducting commerce on public blockchains counteracts corruption because every transaction becomes publicly visible and traceable to both consumers and the government, removing the untraceability that corrupt dealing requires.
subjectOf.abstract: The transparency and traceability of public blockchain transactions in business and commerce counteracts corruption. Using public blockchains in commerce makes every and all transactions publicly visible and traceable for consumers and the government alike.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396522
scope_conditions: requires use of public rather than permissioned blockchains

subjectOf.text: A precedent and citation WDAG accounting system documents and traces every adjustment to a federated learning model, and that full accounting is what enables dynamic feedback effects and the rapid integration of new techniques.
subjectOf.abstract: This setup enables fully accounted dynamic feedback effects for rapid integration of new techniques and approaches to FL. This, in turn, ensures that the models remain cutting-edge and are quickly adaptable to new challenges and opportunities in AI development.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607
scope_conditions: governance of iteratively updated federated learning models

subjectOf.text: An immutable blockchain log of transactions and modifications inside AI systems lets stakeholders trace the lineage of an AI decision back to its original data inputs, which makes errors easier to identify and correct.
subjectOf.abstract: This feature allows stakeholders to track the lineage of AI decisions back to their original data inputs, enabling easier identification and correction of errors.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807
scope_conditions: where AI data inputs and modifications are recorded on an immutable ledger

subjectOf.text: Linking every contributor action and every piece of data to on-chain governance elements within a structured graph is what enables real-time community oversight, iterative updates, and granular reputation tracking in the WDAG model.
subjectOf.abstract: By enabling every contributor action and piece of data to be linked to on-chain governance elements in a structured graph, the WDAG model supports real-time community oversight, iterative updates, and granular reputation tracking.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
scope_conditions: contributions and governance elements are recorded on chain
